Hi Lee,

Congrats again on the close. Quick question from our billing team as we prepare the June invoices and set up payment routing: can you confirm the exact legal payee name and bank wiring instructions that Redwood should use for payments moving forward? Our finance ops needs a clear cutover date and a copy of any tax/VAT registration documentation so we map invoices to the correct entity.

Specifically could you confirm:
- Legal payee name to appear on the invoice remittance (full legal name + any DBA)
- Effective cutover date for new payee (we assume 2027-06-01 but want confirmation)
- Bank wire instructions + IBAN/SWIFT for USD wires (please attach PDF stub if available)
- VAT / tax identifiers for the new entity and whether older invoices (pre-close) remain payable to the legacy company

We also need to know whether you require us to reissue any invoices dated before the cutover to the new payee for accounting consolidation, or whether we should leave historic invoices billed to the legacy entity and mark them in our ledger as cleared. If you prefer a DocuSign change-of-payee, please include the link.

Target timeline on our side: if we have confirmation by end of next week (May 28), we can schedule a brief ops change window to route wires and update NetSuite/SAP mappings ahead of June 1.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn on this,

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
